
## PROJECT OVERVIEW

This is an experimental, hackathon-style project to build a benchmark framework for using AI models to predict well log data. The goal is to deliver a working framework in a short amount of time with an AI agent workforce.

Keep the benchmark comparable across model types: use a consistent, standardized setup for inputs and outputs so models can be evaluated within the same framework. Briefly document important agent decisions—such as data preparation, model selection, and data representations—so the reasoning behind the benchmark is clear without creating overly verbose documentation.
